disambiguation: Not an AI assistant; it is a dictionary search tool activated by a specific keyboard shortcut.
extras: Plugin is not affiliated with MONOKAKIDO Co. Ltd. (JAPAN).
intentEvidence: During editing, simply double-press the option key to search with the Dictionaries by Monokakido.
problem: Users need a quick and easy way to access specialized dictionaries while actively writing or editing notes.
summary: A dictionary search tool that allows users to access specialized dictionaries by Monokakido by double-pressing the Option key while editing.
